description: This source file defines an enumeration 'PdfBlockLevelElementTag' within the PdfSharp.UniversalAccessibility namespace. It enumerates various PDF block-level structural tags used for universal accessibility, such as paragraphs, headings, lists, and table elements, with some obsolete alias values.
